body.objective: Assemble the complete fully rearranged selected-packet q10 coefficient in the direct auxiliary frame after the finite-time triangle and bubble-with-bridge blocks are known.
activates: the first complete selected finite-time probability correction beyond q8
an exact cancellation of apparent Rt source and detector dressing at q10
the next standard-projector and Eq. 19 transport gate
body.current_gate: Use g=lambda^2 evenness, fully rearranged support, normal ordering and finite-ideal similarity invariance to decide whether y5, vacuum, survival or dressing terms remain after the complete connected T6 loop is assembled.
body.stop_condition: Land a strict coefficient certificate and independent verifier for the exact selected-packet q10 functional, graph and normalization exhaustion, Rt dressing cancellation, common-Born identity and order-lambda10 RG cancellation.
body.forbid: no exact packet functional called a packet-independent number or sign; no selected normal-ordering result called scheme independent; no shift-breaking selected scalar pullback promoted to the standard Eq. 19 projector, gravity, BV-BRST or LORENTZIAN-CAUSAL physics
body.resource_hint: On the fixed direct auxiliary carrier H_int=g V with g=lambda^2. Fully rearranged support removes the one-vertex spectator block, so A_YX=g^2 T4+g^3 T6+O(g^4) and y5_fixed=0. A coefficientwise two-sided Rt similarity makes the full selected scalar probability equal to the fixed-BT probability; its apparent y5 norm cancels the second-order dressing cross. In the normal-ordered massless scheme no one-vertex vacuum factor survives, forward survival is off support, and T6 is triangle plus bubble-with-bridge.
